relatedItems.titleZh: 威廉姆斯车队卡洛斯晋级Q2，亚历克斯止步Q1
relatedItems.summaryZh: 卡洛斯在排位赛中晋级到Q2，位列第16位；亚历克斯则排在第17位，未能晋级。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Carlos is through to Q2 in P16 ⏰ That’s the end of Alex’s qualifying as he finishes in P17.
relatedItems.summaryEn:
Carlos is through to Q2 in P16 ⏰
That’s the end of Alex’s qualifying as he finishes in P17.
detailZh: 卡洛斯是威廉姆斯车队的车手，他在排位赛中成功晋级到Q2，位列第16位。而亚历克斯，同样是威廉姆斯车队的车手，他的排位赛到此结束，最终排名第17位。
detailEn:
Carlos is through to Q2 in P16 ⏰
That’s the end of Alex’s qualifying as he finishes in P17.

relatedItems.summaryZh: 第一节的比赛在还剩11分钟时恢复进行。

relatedItems.titleZh: 红旗出动，阿隆索赛道停车，Q1阶段安东内利位于第4，阿莱克斯第8
relatedItems.summaryZh: 阿隆索在Q1阶段赛道停车，导致红旗出动。此时，安东内利位于第4位，阿莱克斯位于第8位。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Red flag is out as ALO stops on track 🚩 At this stage of Q1 Carlos is sitting in P4 with Alex in P8.
relatedItems.summaryEn:
Red flag is out as ALO stops on track 🚩
At this stage of Q1 Carlos is sitting in P4 with Alex in P8.
detailZh:
红旗已经亮起，因为阿隆索在赛道上停下 🚩
在Q1的这个阶段，卡洛斯坐在第4位，而亚历克斯在第8位。
detailEn:
Red flag is out as ALO stops on track 🚩
At this stage of Q1 Carlos is sitting in P4 with Alex in P8.
